identity.name: Tank Louis Cartier Large
identity.one_liner: The Tank Louis Cartier in 18k yellow gold with the automatic 1847 MC — the most-cited Asian Tank, the watch Roger Moore and YSL wore in 1972.

provenance_events.description: Louis Cartier designs the Tank in 1917, inspired by the Renault FT-17 tank tracks he saw in WWI. The Tank becomes Cartier's most-photographed watch.

narrative.story: The Tank Louis Cartier is the dress-Tank — the rectangle case, the Roman numerals, the cabochon crown, the leather strap. The WGTA0211 is the 33.7mm Large size in 18k yellow gold with the automatic 1847 MC.
narrative.collector_notes: The 33.7mm is the Large size — it's the same case size that Cartier has used since 1922, when the Tank was first sold commercially.
